title: Missing notices are presented as proof the result never changed

finding.title: Missing notices are presented as proof the result never changed
finding.page_quote: no result-change notice for this topic in docs/result_changes.json at this build: the served result has not changed since first publication.

evidence.quote: Pool changed because a design refusal was added: reconstructed cluster, crossover, cluster-crossover, and stepped-wedge trials require a held design-adjusted effect or an ICC design-effect variance before this engine can consume them.
Any earlier same-scope k/parity note is superseded for this build

finding.why: The review explicitly records a changed pool. Absence of a result-change notice does not establish an unchanged publication history.
finding.fix: State only that no result-change notice is recorded; disclose the recorded design-refusal change separately.

title: Mortality forest silently omits the contributing PLUS trial

finding.title: Mortality forest silently omits the contributing PLUS trial
finding.page_quote: <svg viewBox='0 0 640 116' role='img' aria-label='Forest plot: Mortality' style='max-width:100%;height:auto;font:12px system-ui'><line x1='456.6' y1='24' x2='456.6' y2='92' stroke='#78909c' stroke-dasharray='3 3'/><line x1='190.0' y1='30.0' x2='580.0' y2='30.0' stroke='#37474f'/><rect x='376.5' y='27.0' width='6' height='6' fill='#1d3b4d'/><text x='6' y='34.0' fill='#12232e'>34375394</text><text x='586' y='34.0' fill='#37474f'>0.97 [0.9, 1.05]</text><text x='190' y='110' fill='#546e7a'>pooled first-event ratio (1 HR + 1 RR) (log scale, null=1)</text></svg>

evidence.quote: PLUS has no committed published HR in the cached abstract; the row has counts only. The outcome decision prefers HR where committed, so PLUS remains a reconstructed RR until the full-text HR is retrieved.

finding.why: The plot shows only PMID 34375394 although its axis describes one HR plus one RR. PLUS contributes to the synthesis but has neither a plotted row nor a stated omission reason.
finding.fix: Show the contributing RR on the correctly labelled mixed-measure plot, or explicitly identify the omitted trial and explain why it cannot be plotted.

title: Same-question verdict conflicts with the recorded comparator qualification

finding.title: Same-question verdict conflicts with the recorded comparator qualification
finding.page_quote: ✓ same question.

evidence.quote: The 2012 Heart meta-analysis (PMID 22442198) is a RELATED, BROADER comparator, not a same-scope one: it pooled more trials including open-label studies and mixed primary/secondary prevention (first-attack and recurrent) populations, whereas this review pools double-blind recurrence-outcome trials. Treat the overlap as approximate.

finding.why: The unqualified positive verdict conflicts with the same tab's source-backed explanation that the comparator is broader and overlap is approximate.
finding.fix: Qualify the verdict as a related, broader comparator and retain the recorded scope differences.

title: Conclusion labels increased ovulation odds as harm

finding.title: Conclusion labels increased ovulation odds as harm
finding.page_quote: directionharm

evidence.quote: Metformin ARM WORSE than placebo (an S2 add-on-to-clomifene contrast; treatment-naive PCOS).

finding.why: The table faithfully copies the claim field, but its clinical interpretation conflicts with the outcome orientation. The pooled OR exceeds one for ovulation; the source describes reduced ovulation as worse. Calling the opposite direction harm reverses that meaning. The interval crossing one does not establish either benefit or harm.
finding.fix: Flag the source claim's direction conflict and correct it upstream using outcome-specific benefit orientation; retain the uncertainty conveyed by the confidence interval.

title: Served converted interval conflicts with the displayed D7 rule

finding.title: Served converted interval conflicts with the displayed D7 rule

evidence.quote: CI CONVERTED: source reports HR 0.87 with a 97.5% CI 0.73-1.04 (multiplicity-adjusted for the two edoxaban doses); converted to a 95% CI 0.745-1.016
is kept for MATCHING only (the G1 tracker may verify a trial with it) and NEVER enters a served pool: a served row's numbers must be printed verbatim in a held span.

finding.why: The new extraction table presents this converted interval as a pooled input while Protocol presents D7 as a decision in force. The review explicitly identifies the interval as re-expressed, which the displayed rule prohibits in a served pool.
finding.fix: Expose this rule-versus-served-data conflict explicitly until the source review is reconciled with D7 or a documented exception.

title: Same-question label conceals recorded treatment-versus-prevention mismatch

finding.title: Same-question label conceals recorded treatment-versus-prevention mismatch
finding.page_quote: ✓ same question. Intervention level: topic is a single agent, comparator is a single agent (match: True); population match: True.

evidence.quote: 1/5. Gap = WOMAN-2 / TRAAP / TRAAP-2 / TXA-MFMU. Reachable (all found in PubMed) but EXCLUDED BY SCOPE, not a search failure: every one tests PROPHYLACTIC tranexamic acid around delivery to PREVENT PPH, whereas this review pools TREATMENT of clinically diagnosed PPH (the WOMAN trial estimand). A prophylaxis-vs-treatment PICO mismatch; the comparator mixes the two.

finding.why: The label follows the coarse scope flags but omits the explicit mismatch recorded in reproduction.parity.reason. Readers are told the questions match even though the comparator combines prevention and treatment, while this review addresses treatment.
finding.fix: Qualify the scope label with the recorded prevention-versus-treatment mismatch and describe the comparison as partial.
